newsitem.title: UK: Mackie shares plunge on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Mackie shares plunge on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Mackie International Plc plummeted on Thursday after the engineering group warned that weak sales of textile machinery meant current profit expectations were too optimistic.
The stock was marked down 31p at 156-1/2 by 0955 GMT, though no trades were recorded in the stock.

In a trading statement, Mackie said the climate in the textile machinery business remained difficult and that the severity of the setback in sales "will result in a reduction in profit expectations for the current year."
However, other divisions were healthy and Mackie said it was confident of making a strong recovery from the setback.
